correctness.rationale: For every reverse path the SCC condensation eventually stabilizes. For any finite k its length-k initial segment is closable to a periodic path in the component; uniform inverse contraction gives Hausdorff distance at most lambda^-k, proving the upper inclusion. Infinite periodic inverse branch lifts from the fixed target prove the converse. Point-versus-open-cell coding handles endpoints. Minkowski arcs show Baire-one in K([0,1]), and an exact four-branch map produces a genuine jump. Finite checker verifies only that example.
